newsitem.title: UK: LS straight-run fuel oil up $2, Russians steady.
newsitem.headline: LS straight-run fuel oil up $2, Russians steady.

text.p: Straight run fuel prices on Tuesday were stable for high sulphur Russian grades but up $2 a tonne for low sulphur cargoes due to bigs gains on the underlying cracked market. Several prompt Russian cargoes were heard on offer and at least one was sold on Monday. A cargo of cracked M-100 at anchor was offered at $111.50 but attracted bids no better than $110.00. Low sulphur was pegged around $128 a tonne fob NWE after recent trade near $125. Dealers said the underlying low sulphur cracked market was about $125 by the close.
